optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in building weekly schedules, resolving conflicts, aligning call-offs, reporting adherence, and documenting open items as described in the job requirements. The materials do not establish whether the candidate held their ground with shift managers when challenged, as the conflict log records resolutions but does not specify the candidate's role in resisting challenges.

decisionBoundary.statement: Qualified human review is required before any employment decision due to the need to verify the candidate's ability to hold their ground with shift managers when challenged.

evidence.text: Production planner at a carton packaging plant with six converting lines for four years, building each week's line schedule from the order book and the capacities of the six lines under the plant's scheduling procedure.

Resolved the schedule conflicts raised by the three shift managers in the daily schedule meeting, with the conflict log recording each challenge, the resolution and the schedule adherence afterwards; adherence stayed above the plant target in fifteen of the sixteen quarters.
evidence.notes: Records resolution but does not specify candidate's role in resisting challenges

evidence.text: Kept the material call-offs aligned with the schedule with the materials buyer through the weekly call-off review.
Reported schedule adherence to the plant manager each week, recording in the report which schedule changes were mine and which were the plant manager's decisions.
Wrote the open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next planning week at each weekly report.
